items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: he published that number with Charlie Cook's band in Patty Harmon's Dreamer.

ctx.x: Yeah, we could hear him already.

Yeah, we got all the greatest bands you want to hear. That was a really a good band. They were really great. And we got along pretty good, but most of those fellows, as we will get back to myself about recording and numbers recording, I'm something like Freddie Kepler was if you never heard about it. I heard he wouldn't play or nothing. Anybody around going to catch anything? He laid it on down and he said, go on about your business, you ain't going to steal nothing from me. See? Well, that's the way I was. And…
There was one that's called Messin' Around.
